items.file: Palestinian flag handed to Shaukat Ali by Amin Al-Husseini and other figures in Jerusalem, 1931.jpg
items.title: Palestinian flag handed to Shaukat Ali by Amin Al-Husseini and other figures in Jerusalem, 1931
items.description: 1931 photograph showing handing the Palestinian flag with a drawing of the Dome of the Rock to Shaukat Ali, the Indian Muslim leader, along a veiled woman and several other figures including, from the right, Sheikh Yaqoub al-Bukhari, Hajj Amin al-Husseini, Shaukat Ali, Sheikh Abdel-Qader al-Muthaffar and Ibrahim Darwish. Possibly taken when Shaukat Ali was organizing the World Muslim Conference in
